summary: Drew County, AR look-see tree near Coleman: a white oak with climbing pegs and a platform used by the Arkansas Forestry Commission c.1930-1940; NRHP-listed 2008.

facts.design: Large white oak with climbing pegs, a wood-framed platform and a telephone line (no structure)
facts.status_note: Tree still standing and healthy in 2010; nomination found most of the platform gone and the telephone line removed

access.note: NRHP nomination marks the property as privately owned; no public access or visiting information found

events.note: Climbing pegs, a platform and a telephone line were added; the Forest Lookouts page dates this to the latter part of the 1930s, the nomination says use began about 1930
Use as a lookout ended about 1940 (nomination and Wikipedia); a fire tower took over its function
Telephone line removed; a white porcelain insulator remains on the tree
Added to the National Register of Historic Places January 23, 2008
Forest Lookouts page: the tree was still standing and healthy in 2010

corrections.why: Forest Lookouts and the NRHP nomination describe a large white oak with climbing pegs and a platform, not a tower; the vocabulary's tree kind fits
The NRHP nomination's ownership section marks the property as private; the Arkansas Forestry Commission operated the lookout but the nomination does not record state ownership

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The nomination says the tree was used between about 1930 and 1940 and was large enough by about 1930; the Forest Lookouts page places the pegs and platform in the latter part of the 1930s. The story reports both and does not pick one.
Forest Lookouts calls the site Coleman (Tree); the nomination and Wikipedia call it the Look See Tree, at the same corner of AR 83 and Pleasant Springs Road. The story uses both names.

notes_for_editor: The nomination text is OCR, so quotes come from the cached OCR and may differ from the printed form. Its condition description dates from the nomination (listed January 2008), not from today; 2010 is the latest status found. The record's kind 'tower' and ownership 'state' are corrected above. Agency comes from the Forest Lookouts page and the nomination's history. No visit or access information found.
